runners_data.name: Smooth Silesie
runners_data.note: Confirmed front-runner who will look to make all but faces in-form Magna for early supremacy

runners_data.name: Magna
runners_data.note: Hat-trick seeking leader in excellent form for Tony Carroll with strong 5f record on this surface

runners_data.name: Star Marian
runners_data.note: Hold-up performer who won over 5f here last time and benefits from Loughnane's 7lb claimer

runners_data.name: Midnight Call
runners_data.note: Prominent racer with excellent course record who can benefit if the two leaders clash early

runners_data.name: Little Jaybee
runners_data.note: Hold-up type with fading tendencies who needs everything to fall right from the back

runners_data.name: Rotokura Belle
runners_data.note: Prominent runner with 5f win two starts back who needs to avoid the early traffic

runners_data.name: Powernap
runners_data.note: Hold-up mare receiving maximum weight allowance but outclassed at this level

races.paceDynamic: Smooth Silesie and Magna will clash for the early lead, with both confirmed front-runners likely to set a decent gallop over this minimum trip. Four horses (Fantasy Obsessor, Guernsey Lady, Midnight Call, Rotokura Belle) all want prominent positions, creating congestion and potential traffic problems turning for home. The honest pace set by the two leaders, combined with the short 5f distance, will favour those who can get prominent early and avoid the scramble - making this a race for horses with early pace rather than hold-up performers.

scenarios.label: A
scenarios.title: Contested Early Lead
scenarios.trigger: If Smooth Silesie and Magna engage in a speed duel from the gates
scenarios.body: The honest gallop will set up the race perfectly for the prominent racers to pick up the pieces, with those getting the clearest run benefiting most. Midnight Call and Rotokura Belle are best placed to capitalise from their forward positions.

scenarios.label: B
scenarios.title: Magna Dominates Early
scenarios.trigger: If Magna gets first run and controls the pace without serious pressure
scenarios.body: The in-form Tony Carroll runner can dictate terms and prove hard to pass, with her recent hat-trick form putting her ahead of rivals. Any that do get close will need to have tracked her journey throughout.

scenarios.label: C
scenarios.title: Prominent Traffic Chaos
scenarios.trigger: If the four prominent runners get bunched up turning for home
scenarios.body: The lack of early pace pressure allows hold-up horses Star Marian and Little Jaybee to be delivered late with clear runs. Star Marian's recent 5f win shows she has the tactical speed to capitalise.

scenarios.label: D
scenarios.title: Smooth Silesie Wire Win
scenarios.trigger: If Smooth Silesie can steal a march and get first run on Magna
scenarios.body: The Lisa Williamson mare holds on grimly from the front, with her proven 5f ability just enough to resist late challenges. Recent course experience gives her the tactical edge.

watchPoints.text: Smooth Silesie and Magna must be monitored for how hard they go in the opening two furlongs as it will determine the race shape
Watch Fantasy Obsessor, Midnight Call, and Rotokura Belle for traffic problems approaching the home turn with limited racing room
Little Jaybee's finishing effort needs tracking as she has shown a tendency to fade in the final furlong
Star Marian's positioning turning for home will be crucial given her hold-up style in a likely fast-run race
Monitor Tony Carroll's double-handed approach with both Magna leading and Midnight Call prominent

races.name: Sky Sports Fillies' Handicap

runners_data.name: Symbol Of Majesty
runners_data.note: Prominent runner with excellent recent form and Gosden stable in good form, ideally positioned to track and strike

runners_data.name: City Queen
runners_data.note: Hold-up performer who needs pace to aim at but has strong form figures and proven course winner

runners_data.name: Estissa
runners_data.note: Prominent style suits the likely pace scenario though trainer out of form over past 14 days

runners_data.name: Lyra Lea
runners_data.note: Prominent runner returning from 218-day break but carries just 122lbs and has won fresh before

runners_data.name: Silken Bay
runners_data.note: Hold-up style needs strong pace but fitted with headgear and comes from yard hitting 11% strike-rate

runners_data.name: Morven
runners_data.note: Hold-up runner returning from 210-day absence with no recent form but proven class on softer surfaces

runners_data.name: Golden Mabel
runners_data.note: Front-runner making handicap debut off low mark but has fading tendency and inexperienced 5lb claimer aboard
runners_data.comment: Huge prices and well beaten in three fillies' novices this year.
runners_data.spotlight: Huge prices and well beaten in three fillies' novices this year; makes no appeal on handicap debut.

races.paceDynamic: Golden Mabel will lead from the start but her known tendency to fade in the finish means she'll create a honest gallop without setting a breakneck pace. Symbol Of Majesty, Estissa, and Lyra Lea will track the leader in prominent positions, while City Queen, Silken Bay, and Morven will settle further back looking to deliver late challenges. The moderate early pace set by a fading leader will allow the prominent runners to stay in touch without expending too much energy. This tactical setup clearly favours the prominent runners who can track the pace and kick when Golden Mabel weakens.

scenarios.label: A
scenarios.title: Prominent Runners Dominate
scenarios.trigger: If Golden Mabel sets a steady pace and fades as expected in the final furlong
scenarios.body: The prominent trackers will be perfectly positioned to strike when the leader weakens, with Symbol Of Majesty's form advantage proving decisive. This moderate gallop suits horses who can stay close without over-racing.

scenarios.label: B
scenarios.title: Hold-Up Horse Strikes
scenarios.trigger: If the pace collapses completely when Golden Mabel fades early
scenarios.body: City Queen or Morven will benefit from a slowly-run race that becomes a sprint finish. The quality runners held up will have too much class for their rivals in a tactical affair.

scenarios.label: C
scenarios.title: Golden Mabel Holds On
scenarios.trigger: If Golden Mabel receives an uncontested lead and her 5lb claimer rides a patient race
scenarios.body: The front-runner could steal a march if the field allows her too much rope early. Her lack of finishing kick becomes irrelevant if she builds an unassailable advantage.

scenarios.label: D
scenarios.title: Pace Collapses Early
scenarios.trigger: If Golden Mabel stops quickly and no other horse wants the lead
scenarios.body: The race becomes a messy affair with no clear pace, suiting whoever gets the best run through the chaos. Lyra Lea's light weight could prove crucial in a scramble.

watchPoints.text: Golden Mabel could steal the race if given too much rope by prominent runners who fail to pressure the pace early
Symbol Of Majesty must handle the step up to handicap company after winning novice races
City Queen and Morven both return from lengthy breaks and may need the run despite their class advantage
Lyra Lea carries significant weight advantage at 122lbs which could prove decisive in a tight finish
Track how aggressively the prominent runners pressure Golden Mabel in the early stages

races.name: Country & Western Raceday 28th June Handicap

runners_data.name: Bizou
runners_data.note: Likely pace-setter returning to optimal 10f distance after two wins, with Rob Hornby a positive jockey booking for the stable

runners_data.name: Dingwall
runners_data.note: Classic hold-up performer with excellent course record and consistent recent form, perfectly suited to picking off moderate pace

runners_data.name: Karakula
runners_data.note: Prominent racer with strong recent form including course win, Oisin Murphy booking suggests confidence despite 27-day break

runners_data.name: Between Me And U
runners_data.note: Prominent runner returning after 284-day absence with tongue-tie first time, long layoff creates uncertainty despite previous course form

runners_data.name: Stipulation
runners_data.note: Patient hold-up horse with course and distance victory last year, consistent recent efforts suggest another bold showing likely
runners_data.comment: Completed a brace when scoring over C&D last September off 4lb lower.
runners_data.spotlight: Completed a brace when scoring over C&D last September off 4lb lower; has run consistently since and looks capable of winning another race such as this.

runners_data.name: Age Of Baroque
runners_data.note: Hold-up horse with topspeed rating of 62 but mixed recent form, needs career-best effort to feature prominently

runners_data.name: Silkies Sib
runners_data.note: Hold-up specialist carrying 9lb less than rivals with visor fitted, strong recent placed efforts and excellent trainer strike-rate

runners_data.name: The Ubermensch
runners_data.note: Hold-up horse with low topspeed rating of 34 using 7lb claimer, recent second at course suggests some hope despite limitations

races.paceDynamic: Bizou will look to take up the running from the start, with Karakula likely to sit prominent in second. The pace should be sustainable rather than frantic given the lack of multiple confirmed front-runners, allowing the field to stay compact through the middle stages. This sets up perfectly for the hold-up horses like Dingwall, Stipulation, Age Of Baroque, Silkies Sib and The Ubermensch to get into contention turning for home. The moderate early gallop and strong closer contingent clearly favours hold-up horses who can pick off the leaders in the final two furlongs.

scenarios.label: A
scenarios.title: Closers Dominate Finish
scenarios.trigger: If the early pace is moderate as expected with Bizou setting uncontested fractions
scenarios.body: The hold-up brigade gets the perfect setup to unleash finishing kicks, with Dingwall and Stipulation ideally positioned to strike. Multiple closers will be in contention late, creating a cavalry charge finish that suits their patient tactics.

scenarios.label: B
scenarios.title: Prominent Pair Hold On
scenarios.trigger: If Bizou and Karakula establish a clear advantage and the pace quickens enough to string out the field
scenarios.body: The two prominent runners may have enough left in the tank to resist the late charge, particularly with their class advantage. Karakula's finishing kick from a forward position could be decisive.

scenarios.label: C
scenarios.title: Silkies Sib Late Surge
scenarios.trigger: If the pace collapses completely and becomes a sprint finish from three furlongs out
scenarios.body: The 9lb weight advantage becomes crucial in a sprint scenario, allowing Silkies Sib to quicken past tiring rivals. His superior topspeed rating of 67 would come into play in a raw speed battle.

scenarios.label: D
scenarios.title: Tactical Chaos Benefits
scenarios.trigger: If the early pace is crawling and jockeys get caught in a stop-start rhythm
scenarios.body: Experienced campaigners like Between Me And U could benefit from a messy tactical affair despite the long layoff. Age Of Baroque might also thrive if the race develops into a scrimmage.

watchPoints.text: Bizou setting overly strong fractions early could compromise his finishing kick and play into the hands of patient closers
Karakula's 27-day break after consistent form - any signs of rustiness in the preliminaries would be concerning
Between Me And U wearing tongue-tie for first time after 284-day absence - market support would indicate serious intent
The pace collapsing too much in the middle stages could turn this into a sprint finish favouring Silkies Sib's topspeed
Multiple hold-up horses getting caught in traffic late given the tactical nature - clean passages will be crucial

runners_data.name: Dontwaste A Moment

races.paceDynamic: Okiru, The Anthony Gover, and Jowalla will ensure a strong gallop from the gates with three confirmed front-runners committed to leading. This genuine pace will stretch the field and test stamina reserves over the 7f trip at Wolverhampton. The early fractions will be solid, creating a race where those able to settle and finish strongly will have a clear advantage. Hold-up horses like Court Of Stars, Espona Bay, Horwich, and Sprinting Speed are ideally positioned to benefit from this pace scenario.

scenarios.label: A
scenarios.title: Strong Pace Favours Closers
scenarios.trigger: If all three front-runners go forward and maintain a genuine gallop
scenarios.body: The sustained pace will set up perfectly for Court Of Stars and Espona Bay to close from the rear. Hold-up horses with proven finishing kicks will find weakening leaders in the final furlong.

scenarios.label: B
scenarios.title: Moderate Pace Suits Prominent
scenarios.trigger: If one front-runner drops out early leaving a steadier tempo
scenarios.body: Seeing Stars and Perfect Location can track the reduced pace and have enough left to outstay the leaders. Their prominent racing style becomes optimal in a more tactical affair.

scenarios.label: C
scenarios.title: Front-Runner Gets Loose
scenarios.trigger: If Okiru or The Anthony Gover steals a significant early advantage
scenarios.body: The loose leader could prove difficult to peg back if getting soft sectionals alone. Jowalla or whichever front-runner secures the most economical trip benefits from reduced early pressure.

scenarios.label: D
scenarios.title: Messy Start Scramble
scenarios.trigger: If the three leaders clash early and compromise each other's positions
scenarios.body: The pace scenario breaks down completely with early interference among the speed horses. This random outcome could favour any horse avoiding the early trouble regardless of running style.

watchPoints.text: Okiru could dictate the race if Hollie Doyle gets her settling better than recent runs suggest
Perfect Location's return from 18-day break with headgear changes could produce significant improvement
Court Of Stars has the ideal hold-up style for this pace setup but needs the leaders to go fast enough
The Anthony Gover and Jowalla may compromise each other if both insist on leading early
Espona Bay's 58-day freshening break could provide the edge needed for her closing style to be effective

races.name: Sky Sports Racing Virgin 512 Fillies' Handicap

runners_data.name: Desert Belle
runners_data.note: Prominent runner with excellent recent form including a course win, looks well-placed to track Romantic Spirit and strike late under Luke Morris

runners_data.name: Romantic Spirit
runners_data.note: Natural front-runner with proven stamina who can dictate the pace without pressure from other early types, 20 days since last run ideal

runners_data.name: You Got To My Soul
runners_data.note: Hold-up performer who needs pace to aim at but has solid recent third-place efforts, headgear change with cheekpieces added suggests connections seeking improvement

runners_data.name: Free Speech
runners_data.note: Patient type with decent staying form but faces traffic concerns from the back, 17-day turnaround keeps her sharp

runners_data.name: Pyleates
runners_data.note: Long-absent hold-up horse returning after 168 days off, previous course form suggests she handles the track well

runners_data.name: Kelly Burn
runners_data.note: Talented hold-up performer who finished second last time at this course and distance, significantly better handicap mark than that effort

races.paceDynamic: Romantic Spirit will take the field along from the front with minimal early pressure, as Desert Belle is the only other forward-going type but prefers to sit just behind rather than lead. This creates a sustainable gallop through the middle sections, with four hold-up horses (You Got To My Soul, Free Speech, Pyleates, Kelly Burn) tracking behind in the pack. The lack of pace pressure means Romantic Spirit can dictate fractions and potentially steal a march, while the patient types will need the pace to collapse late. This race shape clearly favours the front-runner and prominent racer who can avoid traffic problems that may hinder the large hold-up contingent.

scenarios.label: A
scenarios.title: Front Runner Dominates
scenarios.trigger: If Romantic Spirit gets easy fractions and kicks clear turning for home
scenarios.body: Romantic Spirit uses her tactical advantage to build an unassailable lead, while the hold-up horses struggle to make up ground from their crowded positions. The sustainable pace plays perfectly into the leader's stamina reserves.

scenarios.label: B
scenarios.title: Hold-Up Charge Succeeds
scenarios.trigger: If the pace collapses in the final two furlongs and traffic clears
scenarios.body: The patient tactics pay dividends as fresher hold-up horses sweep past a tiring leader in the closing stages. You Got To My Soul and Kelly Burn benefit most from their racing room and finishing kicks.

scenarios.label: C
scenarios.title: Prominent Racer Strikes
scenarios.trigger: If Desert Belle positions perfectly to pounce on a weakening Romantic Spirit
scenarios.body: Desert Belle gets the best of both worlds - avoiding early pace pressure but staying close enough to strike when the leader falters. Her recent winning form gives her the confidence to time her challenge perfectly.

scenarios.label: D
scenarios.title: Late Outsider Emerges
scenarios.trigger: If Pyleates benefits from her 168-day break and finds improvement
scenarios.body: The long layoff proves beneficial as Pyleates arrives with renewed vigor, taking advantage of the sustainable pace to showcase hidden ability. Her previous placed efforts at this distance suggest untapped potential.

watchPoints.text: Watch if Romantic Spirit gets soft fractions early - she could prove very hard to catch if allowed to coast
Monitor the hold-up quartet for traffic problems in the straight as four horses with similar tactics could get bunched
Desert Belle's positioning behind Romantic Spirit will be crucial - too far back negates her tactical advantage
You Got To My Soul's headgear change suggests she's been disappointing at home recently
Watch Pyleates for market support given her long absence - any confidence would be significant
